agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover remainder now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, and to the latest-added one when two cuts tie. All 4 e2e tests pass.

The change is in `cuts()` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/Pools.java`, which used to give the remainder to the member with the largest share (earliest added on a tie). Now:
- **Who can get it:** only members who have a cut. Retired members, held people and members out of their dates still get none.
- **Normal case:** among those members, the one whose cut is smallest but not zero gets the remainder.
- **When every cut is 0.00:** the last member that has a cut gets it.

I made no front-end or stored-data changes because the server already sends each member's cut and the screen shows it as given. I also updated the method's doc comment to describe the new rule. That edit was made while the test run was building; it changes only the comment, so the result above still holds.
